correctness.rationale: The factor f coverage set C_w(f) is the union of all positions in all occurrences. A position subset S is an attractor iff it intersects each C_w(f). Removing a superset mask from the antichain preserves the logical hitting constraints. Since every T_k for k≥2 has all three letters, every cardinality-3 attractor has one position per letter. Independently regenerated every T_k (k=0..11), enumerated coverage masks for each distinct substring, and searched all possible letter-class triples by bit-mask intersections, including 20,576,304 raw candidate triples at k=11 length 927; counts match 1,1,2,8,12,16,32,56,112,224,416,832. Source certificate actual entire stage arrays were read and structurally checked: all 12 lengths, unique sorted triple arrays and matching counts; source verify.py and an independently structured verify_independent.py through k=9 were inspected. Exact lower bound each letter occurs implies minimality given nonempty all-triple lists. No extrapolation beyond k=11.
residual_risks: Finite 12-order computation only. Original source verifier for 1-letter/2-letter special cases handled directly; independently checked k0,k1.

value.rationale: The count of all minimum attractors, rather than just their minimum size, is a natural fine-scale repetitiveness invariant; Tribonacci is the canonical ternary episturmian morphic family. Twelve consecutive exact solution sets through length 927 give meaningful structural data, and the 416 at k=10 refutes a naive simple doubling continuation, constraining future all-order characterization. The exact set enumeration is independently useful as a benchmark even without a new infinite recurrence.
residual_risks: A finite table cannot establish any eventual pattern; no more general theorem is implied.

limitations: The independent scratch checker recomputes cardinality counts, not a formal proof for any unexamined k
